spf.comment: Liverpool's unbeaten road record (3-1-0) and superior forward firepower will break through a Palace side missing banned talisman Mateta.

over_under.comment: Palace have failed to score in three straight league outings, while Liverpool's post-Istanbul fatigue will temper excessive scoring volume.

score.comment: A controlled away performance points toward a shutout victory for Liverpool, with 0:2 representing the primary convergence.
